requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Jiangyan government service page retrieved. It links personal, enterprise and public services to the Jiangyan district government-service platform, but does not expose a parcel map/API endpoint.
Official Jiangyan District service page retrieved. It documents integrated transaction, tax and real-estate registration service; no map/API or safe parcel geometry was present.
Current provincial one-window landing page retrieved. It initially shows no city selection in server-rendered HTML; linked JavaScript populates the current administrative options.

Current public configuration retrieved. It lists 泰州市 and 姜堰区 (code 321204) and assigns the route https://www.jszwfw.gov.cn/jsjis/front/login.do?uuid=hUNXsKOjBXxJ. No service URL, schema, CRS or parcel endpoint is included.

The configured Jiangyan route returned the public login page with session/public-key setup and login forms. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, token acquisition or further requests were attempted.

technicalBlocker: No public anonymous map/API route returning a safe parcel identifier plus geometry was exposed by the reachable official pages; the configured Jiangyan route is a login wall.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was not tested against a parcel service because no qualifying public endpoint was discovered. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The coordinate was retained exactly and not shifted.
nextStep: On a later attempt, locate a current officially documented public Jiangyan/Taizhou cadastral viewer or spatial service, then request only a bounded area with safe parcel identifiers and geometry. Independently qualify any adapter before runtime admission.
